verdict.rationale: Evidence pack covers 3D features (rigidbody/collision physics, Gaussian Splatting, Engine, Editor) but contains no mention of sprites, tilemaps, or a 2D physics system — PlayCanvas is documented here purely as a 3D-first engine. This is a fair question for a game engine, but no evidence supports a first-class 2D workflow, so it's 'none' rather than 'na'.
